about: The broom's bristle end in IN-02 (c3f279c6, tail-anchored), tracked by eye at 8 fps on 10% grids (640x360 frames), 2026-09-28. The canvas light trail is emitted here on the video clock. Coordinates are 0-1 of the video frame (x by width, y by height); values outside 0-1 are off-frame (the close chase, ~0.9-2.8 s, keeps the bristles off the left edge). s = the broom's apparent size (1 = the close chase), which scales the sprites. The broom shrinks into the distance at about (0.66, 0.29) and is gone by 4.6 s, so emission stops at emitUntil.
